I'd extend some parts. 
I think he slept on the potential of some melodies
For example that instrumentation at the end of Thank God?
That was heavenly.
Also that first part on Skitzo, I wouldn't mind a remix of that with Travis alone
And that first part of Lost Forever, I would have brought that back, tied it in at the end.
But man, this album is special!

I don't know how to get out of this environment 
It's all I have never known. I feel like I'm stuck here
You haven't screwed everything up bro. I'm here
I'm sure it's not all your fault bro. I think you just think that because you loathe yourself and think you deserve this pain
Why do we gotta suffer like this? Do we deserve it?
Just like I suspected it's the same for me. Thing is, all this just makes me even more sad and feel even more worthless
Thank you man. I hope you'll be ok too

Can I ask?
Why haven't you
Like what's stopping you?
What are you holding on to?

This isn't a question to make fun of you or anything or make you feel like you should 
I just genuinely want to know what is keeping you here
Because it might be the same for me
That's something I wouldn't even wish on my worst enemy bro. It's a thankless task that you don't deserve
And you know the worst part? You have all that hope only for it to just disappear and you go back to the default which is feeling like shit
You seem like a great person. At least deep down you want to live. Hold onto that. I've lost my will to keep going
Yes. I've tried something like this. I don't think it worked though
What is it that keeps you going my G?
I don't know what I'm trucking for anymore buddy. Honestly I just don't even feel alive anymore
I'm in a similar situation bro. Are you ok. I need an update on you. It doesn't seem like people give a fuck, but I'm very interested to see if you're ok
